name: Big Tent
why: A quiet game-end goal of one member per color; fine to chase.

name: Sweet Nothings
why: Hand out 3 silver and take 6 of any colors; rivals get a gift too.

name: Promote
why: Trading up a rival's member stings, but they get yours back and can see the space coming.

name: Hoarder
why: Turning everything white before Cash In is a big setup moment the owner plans for.

name: Regular
why: Small blue drip when buying followers; fine.

name: Stash
why: Resources plus a follower if you recruit; solid, unremarkable.

name: Gather
why: Resources plus a recruit bonus; fine.

name: Money Changers
why: Small white trickle off everyone's follower buys; fine.

name: Build Up
why: Plain resources; does its job.

name: Kidnapper
why: Takes the leader's member on recruit and again every round start, with no answer; feels like being robbed.

name: Tourist
why: Paying followers every round for a spread of colors feels good each round start.

name: Shopaholics
why: Recruiting twice every turn feels powerful.

name: Sleep In
why: Big purple, going last; fine.

name: Polish
why: A simple converter; fine.

name: Splurge
why: Buying an expensive member in round II for a pile of followers is a big moment.

name: Timekeeper
why: Game-end points per purple member; fine.

name: Recluse
why: A small-cult game-end bonus; fine.

name: Gardeners
why: Filling missing colors each round; useful, quiet.

name: Encore
why: Doubling a big On Recruit is a combo moment.

name: Anarchist
why: Swaps a rival's member away every round and they can't stop it; being singled out repeatedly feels bad.

name: Allowance
why: Resources plus a recruit bonus; fine.

name: Caravan
why: A steady resource engine; fine.

name: Volunteer
why: A cheap point; fine filler.

name: Foster Parents
why: Pays off swaps and steals; situational but fine.

name: Recruit Twice
why: Two recruits in a turn feels great.

name: Cover
why: Copying an empty space is handy; fine.

name: Harvest
why: Resources in your choice of colors; fine.

name: Cash In
why: Turning a white stockpile into followers is the payoff turn.

name: Wallflower
why: Doubling every copy makes copy turns feel big.

name: Roadie
why: Green per green member each round; fine.

name: Gossip
why: Followers off skipped turns; fine.

name: Smooth Talkers
why: Silver pays for anything; convenient, not a moment.

name: Peek
why: Arranging the pile and picking from it; fine.

name: Makeover
why: Rearranging resources; fine.

name: Toastmaster
why: A follower per Silver space; fine.

name: Alchemists
why: Resources count as any when recruiting; convenient.

name: Shift Crew
why: Plain points; fine.

name: Desperado
why: Catch-up steals take a bit more resources; mild sting, fine.

name: Recruiter
why: Red per recruit; fine.

name: Snobs
why: Game-end points per blue member; fine.

name: Heiresses
why: One white burst; fine.

name: Patroness
why: Followers when shop members are sent down; fine.

name: Caterer
why: Silver when silver is gifted; fine.

name: Critic
why: Followers when rivals take blue; fine.

name: Impressionist
why: Resources off copies; fine.

name: Extra Hand
why: An extra minion for the round feels powerful.

name: Patriarch
why: Game-end points for a big cult; fine.

name: Envy
why: A catch-up silver bump; fine.

name: Misers
why: Game-end points for held white; fine.

name: Brokers
why: A follower on top of White followers; fine.

name: Exchange
why: Resources into followers; fine.

name: Out of Style
why: Clearing a color from the shop; can deny a rival, but they see it.

name: New Blood
why: Bonus for a new color recruit; fine.

name: Drifters
why: A flexible color count; fine.

name: Dyer
why: Yellow per color held each round; fine.

name: Cashier
why: An instant Cash In on recruit is a satisfying burst.

name: Clerk
why: One red per round for 5 resources is dull to own; nothing to enjoy.

name: Doppelganger
why: Becoming a copy of your best member is a clever moment.

name: Stunt Double
why: Repeating the action you just took; fine.

name: Dabblers
why: Two wild members for the count; fine.

name: Reprise
why: Copying a space you're on; fine.

name: Old Money
why: Game-end points per white member; fine.

name: Shake Down
why: The victim picks their own punishment, pay or lose a member; feels bad.

name: Bell Ringer
why: The trigger is so tangled it almost never fires knowingly; no fun to own.

name: Greatest Hits
why: Firing every On Recruit again is a big combo turn.

name: Jack-of-All-Trades
why: Yellow fills sets; fine.

name: Courier
why: Resources on back-to-back turns; fine.

name: Estate Sale
why: Cast out a member for white; fine.

name: Landlord
why: Steady white; fine.

name: Proselytizers
why: A follower per recruit; fine.

name: Hold Up
why: Skipping the next turn is a fun jab, and the victim gets the turn later.

name: Party Gifts
why: Gifts to rivals pay you followers; everyone's happy.

name: Harmonist
why: Game-end points per full set; fine.

name: Busker
why: Steady green; fine.

name: Melting Pot
why: Resources per member color; fine.

name: Hawker
why: Rivals pay you extra or you get it free; a fun win-either-way moment.
